arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_brand, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.card_brand ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, c.card_brand
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate for each card brand, using only labelled transactions, with the labelled count and fraud count alongside.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Covers all card types (Credit, Debit, Debit (Prepaid)) and the full date range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
